items.title: Wake state on mail
items.detail: Unread mail shows a bolt instead of words: struck through and grey when no wake is scheduled, plain with a countdown when one is. Hover it for the full text.

items.title: Spend in the title bar
items.detail: The title bar shows Today, WTD and MTD spend in UTC across every Work host: OpenRouter billing plus gateway and other providers. If a host is off, ≥ marks the amount as partial and the tooltip names the host.

items.title: All shows every session
items.detail: New agents appear in All right away, under the same day headings as Agents. Icons, titles and times line up across row types.

items.title: Decision details on hover
items.detail: Hover or focus a decision to see the options it offered and which one was chosen, or the written answer.

items.title: Mail and Wake now
items.detail: Mail chips sit at the trailing edge with their icon last, and long titles truncate. Wake now reports woken, already running or the failure reason within 10 seconds.

items.title: Laptop Porter
items.detail: If Porter's chat can't be loaded, it is retried automatically.

limits: Agent photos are not shown yet; rows show initials.
